about_the_game:
NETWORK NODES

Connect to a neon puzzle that will power your brain to its full potential!

Immerse yourself in the captivating cyberspace world of Network Nodes — a minimalist yet infinitely deep puzzle game where each solution opens new possibilities. Connect glowing nodes, create perfect networks, and watch your creations come alive in dazzling neon light!

INTUITIVE MECHANICS, BOTTOMLESS DEPTH

In Network Nodes, simple rules hide boundless complexity. Each node requires a specific number of connections — no more, no less. Draw lines between nodes, maintaining color compatibility and avoiding intersections. Elegant in its simplicity, yet requires mastery to perfect.

FEATURES:

  • Neon Aesthetics: Immerse yourself in a hypnotizing cyberpunk world with pulsating nodes and glowing lines against the cosmic void

  • Over 40 Unique Puzzles: From tutorials to challenges that truly test your logical thinking abilities

  • Progressive Difficulty: Gradually learn new mechanics — colored nodes, universal connections, dynamic activation, and much more

  • Relaxing Experience: No timers, no penalties — just you and the puzzle in a meditative flow

  • Minimalist Design: Clean and elegant interface where nothing distracts you from solving puzzles

FROM NOVICE TO MASTER

Start with simple connections and gradually discover complex concepts of network design. With each level, puzzles become more intricate, introducing new elements: obstacles, multi-colored nodes, cascade activation, and strategic routing.

"Network Nodes perfectly balances accessibility and complexity — each solution brings instant satisfaction, while each new level challenges your understanding."

Dive into the meditative world of logic puzzles and let your mind shine in Network Nodes today!
